Ant Design Icons SVG - shared website and WebView sprite

Source package: @ant-design/icons-svg 4.6.0 (MIT)
Package: https://registry.npmjs.org/@ant-design/icons-svg/-/icons-svg-4.6.0.tgz
Repository: https://github.com/ant-design/ant-design-icons
Package gitHead: 7f2516ac91226d2b41f93b35cb5197c8d94f7189
License source: https://github.com/ant-design/ant-design-icons/blob/7f2516ac91226d2b41f93b35cb5197c8d94f7189/LICENSE
Visual reference: 3X-UI v3.10.2; no 3X-UI business implementation is included.

workspace.svg keeps the original SVG path data and per-symbol viewBox.
All ordinary glyphs use the package's outlined variants; pin-filled uses filled/pushpin and star-filled uses filled/star.
paper-landscape rotates the original FileOutlined paths 90 degrees without rewriting them.
rows-compact, rows-standard and rows-loose are Eredge-owned density glyphs, drawn
only because the source package has no matching three-state row-density set.
They use the same 64 64 896 896 canvas, filled outlines and currentColor.

Compatibility names -> source file in inline-svg/outlined/ unless noted:
fullscreen -> fullscreen; fullscreen-exit -> fullscreen-exit
dashboard -> dashboard; overview -> profile; folder -> folder; hierarchy -> apartment
zoom-in -> zoom-in; zoom-out -> zoom-out
paper-portrait -> file; paper-landscape -> file (rotated); page-fit -> column-width
zero-source -> table; zero-show -> eye; zero-hide -> eye-invisible; thousands -> number
chevron-left -> left; chevron-down -> down; chevron-right -> right
library -> folder-open; restore -> undo; filter -> filter; columns -> table; refresh -> reload
close -> close; close-all -> close-square; trash -> delete; search -> search
expand -> plus-square; collapse -> minus-square; budget -> table
quota -> read; formula -> function; resource -> unordered-list; materials -> build
calculation-mark -> calculator; report -> file-text; settings -> setting; file -> file
upload -> upload; warning -> warning; check -> check; pending -> clock-circle
menu -> menu; pin -> pushpin; pin-filled -> inline-svg/filled/pushpin.svg
sun -> sun; moon -> moon; more -> more; download -> download; logout -> logout; user -> user

Portal additions: portal-home -> home; portal-payment -> credit-card; portal-help -> question-circle.

Calculator actions: menu-fold -> menu-fold; menu-unfold -> menu-unfold; edit -> edit; arrow-up -> arrow-up; arrow-down -> arrow-down; share -> export; link -> link; qrcode -> qrcode; read -> read; book -> book (all inline-svg/outlined/).

Calculator toolbar: save -> save; copy -> copy (inline-svg/outlined/, same pinned package).
